W01.description: Three distinct near-horizontal elongated traces stacked beside a steep/standing trace at their screen-right ends.
W01.strict: Allthree traces and standing trace distinguishable, positions compatible, border/adjacent-mark explanation not dominating.
W01.partial: Two traces clear and third damaged, or standing trace/connection uncertain.
W01.exclude: Bare bundle without standing trace; arbitrary rotation/mirror to force identity.

W02.description: Fan-like curved/angular perimeter with multiple short internal near-parallel traces.
W02.strict: Perimeter distinct from line boundary, at least3 internal traces and their arrangement visible and comparable.
W02.partial: Generic hatch/curve resemblance but closure, count or boundary ambiguous.
W02.exclude: Bare horizontal bundle or generic pointed shape without diagnostic interior.

BUNDLE.description: At least3 short roughly parallel traces without confirmed enclosure or side-standing trace.
BUNDLE.role: Geometric control pattern, not established autonomous sign.
BUNDLE.strict: Three or more distinct traces visible without relying on external known reading.
BUNDLE.partial: Only2 clear traces or border attribution uncertain.

review_rules: Inspect full photo then native crops; record revisions as separate observations.
No statistical genealogy/phonetic claim from these small convenience samples.
Different views of one tablet are not independent objects.
Contacts are image-plane observations; depth/tool motion not established.
